name: Jellyseerr
description: Jellyseerr is a media request manager for Jellyfin, Emby, and Plex. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Jellyseerr as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Media request manager for Jellyfin and Plex. Deploy Jellyseerr with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
